```{r}
  cat("\n")
  all_vars <- all_vars[all_vars %in% names(data_complete)]
  cat("Proceeding with", length(all_vars), "available variables\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE CATEGORICAL VS CONTINUOUS VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Defining variable types for Table 1...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Categorical variables (will be shown as n (%))
cat_vars <- c(
  "sex",                                    # Factor: Female, Male
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",  # Ordinal
  "gen_health",                            # Ordinal
  "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",  # Ordinal frequency
  "stop_wdl_exp_combined"                  # Ordinal withdrawal categories (0-5)
)

# Filter to existing categorical variables
cat_vars <- cat_vars[cat_vars %in% names(data_complete)]

cat("Categorical variables (n, %%):", length(cat_vars), "\n")
cat("  • sex, education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health\n")
cat("  • Sleep aids (alc_sleep, can_sleep, melatonin_use, op_sleep)\n")
cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined\n\n")

cat("Continuous variables (Mean ± SD):", length(all_vars) - length(cat_vars), "\n")
cat("  • All other variables shown as Mean (SD)\n")
cat("  • Includes: age, clinical measures, Likert scales, subscales\n\n")

# All continuous variables shown as Mean (SD)
# No non-normal treatment needed with N=397 (Central Limit Theorem)
nonnormal_vars <- c()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TABLE 1: OVERALL SAMPLE CHARACTERISTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TABLE 1: OVERALL SAMPLE CHARACTERISTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

table1_overall <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = all_vars,
  data = data_complete,
  factorVars = cat_vars
)

# Print to console
print(table1_overall, 
      formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

# Save to CSV
table1_overall_csv <- print(table1_overall, 
                             printToggle = FALSE, 
                             formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

write.csv(table1_overall_csv, "TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TABLE 2: CHARACTERISTICS BY DISCONTINUATION STATUS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TABLE 2: CHARACTERISTICS BY DISCONTINUATION STATUS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Check outcome variable exists
if(!"scrn_stopped_bzra" %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable 'scrn_stopped_bzra' not found in dataset")
}

# Get sample sizes
n_total <- nrow(data_complete)
n_discontinued <- sum(data_complete$scrn_stopped_bzra == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_continued <- sum(data_complete$scrn_stopped_bzra == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Sample sizes by discontinuation status:\n")
cat("  Total:", n_total, "\n")
cat("  Discontinued (1):", n_discontinued, "(", round(100 * n_discontinued / n_total, 1), "%)\n")
cat("  Continued (0):", n_continued, "(", round(100 * n_continued / n_total, 1), "%)\n\n")

# Create stratified table
table2_stratified <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = all_vars,
  strata = "scrn_stopped_bzra",
  data = data_complete,
  factorVars = cat_vars,
  test = TRUE,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

# Print with SMD
print(table2_stratified, 
      smd = TRUE,
      formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

# Save to CSV
table2_stratified_csv <- print(table2_stratified, 
                                smd = TRUE, 
                                printToggle = FALSE, 
                                formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

write.csv(table2_stratified_csv, "TABLE2_by_discontinuation.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: TABLE2_by_discontinuation.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EXTRACT P-VALUES FOR FDR CORRECTION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FDR CORRECTION BY VARIABLE FAMILY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Extracting p-values from tableone object...\n\n")

# Extract the test results from tableone object
table2_for_extraction <- print(table2_stratified, 
                                printToggle = FALSE, 
                                test = TRUE,
                                smd = TRUE,
                                exact = TRUE)  # Get exact p-values

# Convert to data frame
table2_df <- as.data.frame(table2_for_extraction)
table2_df$Variable <- rownames(table2_df)

# Extract p-values and handle "<0.001" strings
table2_df <- table2_df %>%
  filter(Variable != "n") %>%
  mutate(
    p_original = as.character(p),
    P_Value = case_when(
      # Handle "<0.001" format
      grepl("^<", p_original) ~ 0.0001,  # Use 0.0001 as conservative estimate
      # Handle regular numeric values
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(p_original)
    )
  )

cat("P-value conversion summary:\n")
cat("  Values converted from '<0.001':", sum(grepl("^<", table2_df$p_original), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Regular numeric values:", sum(!grepl("^<", table2_df$p_original) & !is.na(table2_df$p_original)), "\n\n")

# Create comprehensive results table with family assignments
pvalue_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  Family = character(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  P_Original = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Assign each variable to its family and extract p-value
for(var in all_vars) {
  # Determine family
  if(var %in% demographics) {
    family <- "Demographics"
  } else if(var %in% clinical) {
    family <- "Clinical"
  } else if(var %in% sleep_adverse) {
    family <- "Sleep_Adverse"
  } else if(var %in% behavioural) {
    family <- "behavioural"
  } else if(var %in% personality) {
    family <- "Personality"
  } else {
    family <- "Unknown"
  }
  
  # Find matching p-value in table2_df
  # Variable names might have suffixes like (%) or (mean (SD))
  matching_rows <- table2_df[grepl(paste0("^", var), table2_df$Variable), ]
  
  if(nrow(matching_rows) > 0) {
    p_val <- matching_rows$P_Value[1]
    p_orig <- matching_rows$p_original[1]
  } else {
    p_val <- NA
    p_orig <- NA
  }
  
  pvalue_results <- rbind(pvalue_results, data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    Family = family,
    P_Value = p_val,
    P_Original = p_orig,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

cat("✓ Extracted p-values for", nrow(pvalue_results), "variables\n\n")

# Show summary of p-value extraction
cat("P-value extraction summary:\n")
cat("  Variables with p-values:", sum(!is.na(pvalue_results$P_Value)), "\n")
cat("  Variables missing p-values:", sum(is.na(pvalue_results$P_Value)), "\n")
cat("  Variables with p < 0.001:", sum(!is.na(pvalue_results$P_Original) & 
                                        grepl("^<", pvalue_results$P_Original)), "\n\n")

# Show variables with very small p-values
very_small_p <- pvalue_results %>% 
  filter(!is.na(P_Original) & grepl("^<", P_Original))

if(nrow(very_small_p) > 0) {
  cat("✓ Variables with p < 0.001 (set to 0.0001 for FDR calculation):\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(very_small_p)) {
    cat("    •", very_small_p$Variable[i], "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

if(sum(is.na(pvalue_results$P_Value)) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  Variables still missing p-values:\n")
  missing_p <- pvalue_results %>% filter(is.na(P_Value))
  for(i in 1:min(10, nrow(missing_p))) {
    cat("    •", missing_p$Variable[i], "\n")
  }
  if(nrow(missing_p) > 10) {
    cat("    ... and", nrow(missing_p) - 10, "more\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# APPLY FDR CORRECTION WITHIN EACH FAMILY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Applying FDR correction within each family...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Apply FDR correction by family
pvalue_results <- pvalue_results %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  mutate(
    P_FDR = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "fdr"),
    Significant_Uncorrected = ifelse(!is.na(P_Value) & P_Value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    Significant_FDR = ifelse(!is.na(P_FDR) & P_FDR < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Family, P_Value)

# Display results by family
for(family in unique(pvalue_results$Family[!is.na(pvalue_results$Family)])) {
  cat("FAMILY:", family, "\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  family_results <- pvalue_results %>% filter(Family == family)
  
  # Count only variables with valid p-values
  valid_p <- family_results %>% filter(!is.na(P_Value))
  
  cat("  Total variables:", nrow(family_results), "\n")
  cat("  Variables with p-values:", nrow(valid_p), "\n")
  cat("  Significant (uncorrected p < .05):", 
      sum(valid_p$Significant_Uncorrected == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Significant (FDR-corrected p < .05):", 
      sum(valid_p$Significant_FDR == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  # Show significant variables
  sig_vars <- family_results %>% 
    filter(Significant_FDR == "Yes") %>%
    select(Variable, P_Value, P_FDR)
  
  if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0) {
    cat("\n  Significant variables (FDR-corrected):\n")
    for(i in 1:nrow(sig_vars)) {
      cat(sprintf("    • %-30s: p = %.4f, p_FDR = %.4f\n", 
                  sig_vars$Variable[i], sig_vars$P_Value[i], sig_vars$P_FDR[i]))
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n  No significant variables after FDR correction\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Save detailed results
write.csv(pvalue_results, "TABLE2_pvalues_with_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: TABLE2_pvalues_with_FDR.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE PUBLICATION-READY TABLE WITH FDR-CORRECTED P-VALUES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CREATING PUBLICATION-READY TABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Clean up variable names for matching
pvalue_results$Variable_Clean <- pvalue_results$Variable

# For each row in table2_df, find the matching variable in pvalue_results
table2_final <- table2_df %>%
  mutate(Variable_Clean = gsub(" \\(.*", "", Variable)) %>%
  mutate(Variable_Clean = trimws(Variable_Clean))

# Join with pvalue results (only select columns that will be in the final table)
table2_final <- table2_final %>%
  left_join(
    pvalue_results %>% select(Variable, Family, P_FDR, Significant_FDR),
    by = c("Variable_Clean" = "Variable")
  ) %>%
  select(-Variable_Clean)  # Only remove Variable_Clean

# Check what columns we have after join
cat("Columns after join:\n")
print(names(table2_final))
cat("\n")

# Remove p_original if it exists
if("p_original" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  table2_final <- table2_final %>% select(-p_original)
}

# Build select statement based on what exists
available_cols <- names(table2_final)

select_cols <- c("Family", "Variable")
if("Overall" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "Overall")
if("0" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "0")
if("1" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "1")
if("p" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "p")
if("P_FDR" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "P_FDR")
if("test" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "test")
if("SMD" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "SMD")
if("Significant_FDR" %in% available_cols) select_cols <- c(select_cols, "Significant_FDR")

table2_final <- table2_final %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols))

# Rename columns
rename_list <- list()

if("P_FDR" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["P_FDR"]] <- "P (FDR-corrected)"
}
if("Significant_FDR" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["Significant_FDR"]] <- "Significant (FDR < .05)"
}
if("Overall" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["Overall"]] <- "Overall (N=397)"
}
if("0" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["0"]] <- "Continued BZRA (n=304)"
}
if("1" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["1"]] <- "Discontinued BZRA (n=93)"
}
if("p" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["p"]] <- "P (uncorrected)"
}
if("test" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["test"]] <- "Test Used"
}
if("SMD" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  rename_list[["SMD"]] <- "Effect Size (SMD)"
}

# Apply renames using rename_with and a function
for(old_name in names(rename_list)) {
  if(old_name %in% names(table2_final)) {
    names(table2_final)[names(table2_final) == old_name] <- rename_list[[old_name]]
  }
}

# Format P_FDR to show <0.001 for very small values
if("P (FDR-corrected)" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  table2_final <- table2_final %>%
    mutate(
      `P (FDR-corrected)` = case_when(
        is.na(`P (FDR-corrected)`) ~ NA_character_,
        `P (FDR-corrected)` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", `P (FDR-corrected)`)
      )
    )
}

write.csv(table2_final, "TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv\n\n")

# Verify FDR values were added
if("P (FDR-corrected)" %in% names(table2_final)) {
  n_with_fdr <- sum(!is.na(table2_final$`P (FDR-corrected)`))
  n_total_rows <- nrow(table2_final)
  cat("Verification:\n")
  cat("  Total rows:", n_total_rows, "\n")
  cat("  Rows with FDR-corrected p-values:", n_with_fdr, "\n")
  
  if(any(table2_final$`P (FDR-corrected)` == "<0.001", na.rm = TRUE)) {
    cat("  Rows with FDR < 0.001:", sum(table2_final$`P (FDR-corrected)` == "<0.001", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  }
  
  cat("  Rows missing FDR:", n_total_rows - n_with_fdr, "\n\n")
  
  # Show which variables are still missing FDR values
  if(n_total_rows - n_with_fdr > 0) {
    missing_fdr <- table2_final %>% 
      filter(is.na(`P (FDR-corrected)`)) %>%
      select(Family, Variable)
    
    if(nrow(missing_fdr) > 0) {
      cat("⚠️  Variables still missing FDR values:\n")
      print(missing_fdr %>% head(10), row.names = FALSE)
      if(nrow(missing_fdr) > 10) {
        cat("  ... and", nrow(missing_fdr) - 10, "more\n")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Warning: P (FDR-corrected) column not found in final table\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT FINDINGS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT FINDINGS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Overall summary
sig_uncorrected <- sum(pvalue_results$Significant_Uncorrected == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
sig_fdr <- sum(pvalue_results$Significant_FDR == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)

cat("OVERALL:\n")
cat("  Total variables tested:", nrow(pvalue_results), "\n")
cat("  Significant (uncorrected p < .05):", sig_uncorrected, 
    "(", round(100 * sig_uncorrected / nrow(pvalue_results), 1), "%)\n")
cat("  Significant (FDR-corrected p < .05):", sig_fdr, 
    "(", round(100 * sig_fdr / nrow(pvalue_results), 1), "%)\n\n")

# By family summary
cat("BY FAMILY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

family_summary <- pvalue_results %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Variables = n(),
    N_Sig_Uncorrected = sum(Significant_Uncorrected == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    N_Sig_FDR = sum(Significant_FDR == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pct_Sig_FDR = round(100 * N_Sig_FDR / N_Variables, 1)
  )

print(family_summary, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

write.csv(family_summary, "TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv\n\n")

# List all significant variables (FDR-corrected)
sig_all <- pvalue_results %>%
  filter(Significant_FDR == "Yes") %>%
  arrange(P_FDR) %>%
  select(Family, Variable, P_Value, P_FDR)

if(nrow(sig_all) > 0) {
  cat("ALL SIGNIFICANT VARIABLES (FDR-corrected p < .05):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  print(sig_all, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  write.csv(sig_all, "TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Saved: TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No variables remain significant after FDR correction\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Sample Characteristics:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("The final sample comprised", n_total, "older adults (mean age =", 
    round(mean(data_complete$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "years, SD =", 
    round(sd(data_complete$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ").\n")

# Sex distribution
if("sex" %in% names(data_complete)) {
  sex_table <- table(data_complete$sex)
  if("Female" %in% names(sex_table)) {
    n_female <- sex_table["Female"]
    pct_female <- 100 * n_female / n_total
    cat("The sample was", round(pct_female, 1), "% female (n =", n_female, ").\n")
  }
}

cat("\nOf the", n_total, "participants,", n_discontinued, "(", 
    round(100 * n_discontinued / n_total, 1), 
    "%) reported discontinuing their BZRA medication,\n")
cat("while", n_continued, "(", round(100 * n_continued / n_total, 1), 
    "%) continued using it.\n\n")

if(nrow(sig_all) > 0) {
  cat("Group Comparisons:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("After FDR correction within variable families, those who discontinued\n")
  cat("differed significantly from those who continued on", nrow(sig_all), "variable(s):\n\n")
  
  for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(sig_all))) {
    cat(sprintf("  • %s (p_FDR = %.4f)\n", 
                sig_all$Variable[i], sig_all$P_FDR[i]))
  }
  
  if(nrow(sig_all) > 5) {
    cat("  ... and", nrow(sig_all) - 5, "additional variable(s)\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("Group Comparisons:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("After FDR correction within variable families, no significant baseline\n")
  cat("differences were observed between those who discontinued and those who\n")
  cat("continued BZRA use.\n\n")
}

cat("Statistical Methods:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Group comparisons used independent samples t-tests for continuous\n")
cat("variables and chi-square or Fisher's exact tests for categorical variables.\n")
cat("False discovery rate (FDR) correction was applied separately within each\n")
cat("variable family: demographics (n =", length(demographics), "),\n")
cat("clinical (n =", length(clinical), "), sleep/adverse effects (n =", 
    length(sleep_adverse), "),\n")
cat("behavioural (n =", length(behavioural), "), and personality (n =", 
    length(personality), ").\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv\n")
cat("  2. TABLE2_by_discontinuation.csv\n")
cat("  3. TABLE2_pvalues_with_FDR.csv\n")
cat("  4. TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv\n")
cat("  5. TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv\n")
if(nrow(sig_all) > 0) {
  cat("  6. TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
cat("  • Total variables tested:", nrow(pvalue_results), "\n")
cat("  • Significant before FDR:", sig_uncorrected, "\n")
cat("  • Significant after FDR:", sig_fdr, "\n")
cat("  • FDR families:", length(unique(pvalue_results$Family)), "\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE FORMATTING:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("CATEGORICAL (n, %%):\n")
cat("  • sex (Female, Male)\n")
cat("  • education, income, employment, driving_freq, gen_health\n")
cat("  • Sleep aids: alc_sleep, can_sleep, melatonin_use, op_sleep\n")
cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined (withdrawal categories 0-5)\n\n")

cat("CONTINUOUS (MEAN ± SD):\n")
cat("  • Demographics: age\n")
cat("  • Clinical: phq2_score, osss_3_score, med_quant\n")
cat("  • Condition counts: n_physical, n_mental, n_sleep, n_health\n")
cat("  • Side effects: side_effects_1-4 (Likert 1-5)\n")
cat("  • Safety: safety_1-4 (Likert 1-5)\n")
cat("  • ADLs: adls_1-2 (Likert 1-5)\n")
cat("  • Dependence: dependence_1-3 (Likert 1-5)\n")
cat("  • Withdrawal count: wdl_symptom_count (0-4)\n")
cat("  • COM-B: motivation_1-3, desires_1-3, capability_1, capability\n")
cat("  • Personality: All BFI, SURPS, DBAS, CISS subscales\n\n")

cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("  → Use TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv for manuscript Table 2\n")
cat("  → Report FDR-corrected p-values in results\n")
cat("  → Cite variable family in methods (e.g., 'Demographics family')\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ CHUNK 10 COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```



## PERS VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important personality variables for BZRA discontinuation
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to personality subscales (BFI, SURPS, DBAS, CISS)
# Rationale: Reduce high-dimensional correlated personality block
# Output: Reduced set of personality predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed data with subscales
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create subscales")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE PERSONALITY VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING PERSONALITY VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Personality subscales (created in Chunk 9)
personality_vars <- c(
  # BFI-10 (Big Five)
  "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
  
  # SURPS (Substance Use Risk Profile)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
  
  # DBAS-16 (Dysfunctional Beliefs About Sleep) - subscales only
  "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
  
  # CISS (Coping Inventory)
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

cat("PERSONALITY VARIABLES (", length(personality_vars), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  BFI-10 (5): Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness\n")
cat("  SURPS (4): Impulsivity, Sensation_Seeking, Hopelessness, Anxiety_Sensitivity\n")
cat("  DBAS-16 (4): Consequences, Worry_Helplessness, Expectations, Medications\n")
cat("  CISS (3): Task, Emotion, Avoidance\n\n")

cat("EXCLUDED:\n")
cat("  • DBAS_Total (sum of subscales - redundant)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- personality_vars[personality_vars %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars <- personality_vars[!personality_vars %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available personality variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(personality_vars), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# RUN VSURF
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")
  
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 8
  selected_vars <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(8, nrow(importance_df))]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_vars[1:min(5, length(selected_vars))]
  
} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }
  
  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Variable importance
cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Top 15):\n")
print(head(importance_df, 15), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY PERSONALITY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
  domain_breakdown <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_vars,
    Domain = case_when(
      grepl("^BFI_", selected_vars) ~ "BFI",
      grepl("^SURPS_", selected_vars) ~ "SURPS",
      grepl("^DBAS_", selected_vars) ~ "DBAS",
      grepl("^CISS_", selected_vars) ~ "CISS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% arrange(Domain, Variable)
  
  domain_summary <- domain_breakdown %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(
      N_Total = case_when(
        Domain == "BFI" ~ 5,
        Domain == "SURPS" ~ 4,
        Domain == "DBAS" ~ 4,
        Domain == "CISS" ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Percent = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)
    )
  
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  for(domain in unique(domain_breakdown$Domain)) {
    vars_in_domain <- domain_breakdown %>% filter(Domain == domain)
    cat(domain, "(", nrow(vars_in_domain), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_domain)) {
      cat("  •", vars_in_domain$Variable[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(15) %>%
    mutate(
      Domain = case_when(
        grepl("^BFI_", Variable) ~ "BFI",
        grepl("^SURPS_", Variable) ~ "SURPS",
        grepl("^DBAS_", Variable) ~ "DBAS",
        grepl("^CISS_", Variable) ~ "CISS",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                              y = Importance, fill = Domain, alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Personality Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_personality_importance.png", p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance.png\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df = importance_df,
  domain_summary = if(exists("domain_summary")) domain_summary else data.frame(),
  metadata = list(
    outcome = outcome_var,
    n_obs = nrow(X),
    n_input = ncol(X),
    n_selected = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_personality_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_personality_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_selected.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
cat("  Sample size:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / length(selected_vars), 1), "\n\n")

cat("SELECTED PERSONALITY VARIABLES:\n")
for(i in seq_along(selected_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("✓ Ready for logistic regression modeling\n\n")
```



## CLIN VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important clinical/health variables for BZRA discontinuation
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to clinical block
# Rationale: Identify key health and medication factors
# Output: Reduced set of clinical predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed data
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE CLINICAL VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING CLINICAL VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Clinical/health variables
clinical_vars <- c(
  # Basic clinical
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant",
  
  # Condition counts
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions", 
  "n_sleep_conditions", "n_health_conditions",
  
  # Sleep aids
  "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",
  
  # Side effects (continuous Likert)
  paste0("side_effects_", 1:4),
  
  # Safety concerns (continuous Likert)
  paste0("safety_", 1:4),
  
  # ADL impact (continuous Likert)
  paste0("adls_", 1:2),
  
  # Dependence (continuous Likert)
  paste0("dependence_", 1:3)
)

# NOTE: Withdrawal variables EXCLUDED (temporal ordering)
# - stop_wdl_exp_combined
# - wdl_symptom_count

cat("CLINICAL VARIABLES (", length(clinical_vars), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Basic Clinical (4): phq2_score, osss_3_score, gen_health, med_quant\n")
cat("  Condition Counts (4): n_physical, n_mental, n_sleep, n_health\n")
cat("  Sleep Aids (4): alc_sleep, can_sleep, melatonin_use, op_sleep\n")
cat("  Side Effects (4): side_effects_1-4\n")
cat("  Safety (4): safety_1-4\n")
cat("  ADLs (2): adls_1-2\n")
cat("  Dependence (3): dependence_1-3\n\n")

cat("EXCLUDED (temporal ordering):\n")
cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined (occurs during cessation)\n")
cat("  • wdl_symptom_count (occurs during cessation)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- clinical_vars[clinical_vars %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars <- clinical_vars[!clinical_vars %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available clinical variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(clinical_vars), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# RUN VSURF
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")
  
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 10
  selected_vars <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(10, nrow(importance_df))]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_vars[1:min(5, length(selected_vars))]
  
} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }
  
  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Variable importance
cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Top 20):\n")
print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CATEGORY BREAKDOWN
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY CLINICAL CATEGORY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
  category_breakdown <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_vars,
    Category = case_when(
      selected_vars %in% c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant") ~ "Basic Clinical",
      grepl("^n_", selected_vars) ~ "Condition Counts",
      selected_vars %in% c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep") ~ "Sleep Aids",
      grepl("^side_effects_", selected_vars) ~ "Side Effects",
      grepl("^safety_", selected_vars) ~ "Safety",
      grepl("^adls_", selected_vars) ~ "ADLs",
      grepl("^dependence_", selected_vars) ~ "Dependence",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% arrange(Category, Variable)
  
  category_summary <- category_breakdown %>%
    count(Category, name = "N_Selected")
  
  print(category_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  for(category in unique(category_breakdown$Category)) {
    vars_in_cat <- category_breakdown %>% filter(Category == category)
    cat(category, "(", nrow(vars_in_cat), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_cat)) {
      cat("  •", vars_in_cat$Variable[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(20) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Variable %in% c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant") ~ "Basic Clinical",
        grepl("^n_", Variable) ~ "Condition Counts",
        Variable %in% c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep") ~ "Sleep Aids",
        grepl("^side_effects_", Variable) ~ "Side Effects",
        grepl("^safety_", Variable) ~ "Safety",
        grepl("^adls_", Variable) ~ "ADLs",
        grepl("^dependence_", Variable) ~ "Dependence",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                              y = Importance, fill = Category, alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Clinical Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_clinical_importance.png", p, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_importance.png\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df = importance_df,
  category_summary = if(exists("category_summary")) category_summary else data.frame(),
  metadata = list(
    outcome = outcome_var,
    n_obs = nrow(X),
    n_input = ncol(X),
    n_selected = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_clinical_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_clinical_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_selected.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
cat("  Sample size:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / length(selected_vars), 1), "\n\n")

cat("SELECTED CLINICAL VARIABLES:\n")
for(i in seq_along(selected_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("✓ Ready for logistic regression modeling\n\n")
```

## DEM VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# VSURF ANALYSIS: DEMOGRAPHICS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Identify which demographic variables are essential confounders
# Rationale: Reduce predictor count to improve EPV
# Strategy: Let VSURF decide which demographics truly predict outcome
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(VSURF)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF ANALYSIS: DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA
#==============================================================================

# Load imputed data
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

#==============================================================================
# PART B: DEFINE DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Define all available demographics
demographics_all <- c("age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

cat("DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES (", length(demographics_all), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Continuous (1): age\n")
cat("  Categorical (5): sex, education, income, employment, driving_freq\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: PREPARE DATA
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation (consistent with personality chunk)
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- demographics_all[demographics_all %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars   <- demographics_all[!demographics_all %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available demographic variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(demographics_all), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

cat("Variable types:\n")
for(var in names(X)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", var, class(X[[var]])))
}
cat("\n")

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: RUN VSURF
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("VSURF settings:\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(X), "demographics\n")
cat("  Trees: 2000\n")
cat("  mtry:", max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1), "\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (this may take 1-2 minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(123)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART E: EXTRACT RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")

  set.seed(123)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)

  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable   = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

  # Select top variables (cap at half of input)
  n_select       <- min(ceiling(ncol(X) / 2), nrow(importance_df))
  selected_vars  <- importance_df$Variable[1:n_select]

  vsurf_threshold    <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction   <- selected_vars[1:min(3, length(selected_vars))]

} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold      <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction     <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]

  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable   = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(123)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable   = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }

  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE:\n")
print(importance_df, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART F: RECOMMENDATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: RECOMMENDATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) == 0) {
  recommendation <- "MINIMAL ADJUSTMENT"
  selected_vars  <- c("age", "sex")  # Default epidemiological confounders
  rationale <- "VSURF found no demographics strongly predictive. Including age and sex\nas standard epidemiological confounders."
} else if(length(selected_vars) <= 2) {
  recommendation <- "PARSIMONIOUS ADJUSTMENT"
  rationale <- sprintf("VSURF selected %d demographic(s). Use these for confounder adjustment.",
                       length(selected_vars))
} else {
  recommendation <- "MODERATE ADJUSTMENT"
  rationale <- sprintf("VSURF selected %d demographics. This maintains balance between\nconfounding control and EPV preservation.",
                       length(selected_vars))
}

cat("RECOMMENDED APPROACH:", recommendation, "\n")

# EPV calculation

#==============================================================================
```

```{r}
# Purpose: Build parsimonious models with optimal EPV using VSURF Prediction

library(tidyverse)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================

cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data (mids object - consistent with VSURF chunks)

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")

# Build imputed list from mids object for pooling
imputed_list <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) complete(mids_data, i))
cat(sprintf("✓ Extracted %d complete datasets\n", length(imputed_list)))

# Load VSURF personality results

vars_m3    <- personality_prediction

# Model 4: VSURF Prediction + Demographics (adjusted optimal model)
vars_m4    <- c(personality_prediction, demographics_vsurf)

epv_m4     <- n_events / length(vars_m4)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Model 1: VSURF Interpretation\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m1)))

cat("Model 2: VSURF Interpretation + Demographics\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m2)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m2, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv_m2))

cat("Model 3: VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY (DATA-DRIVEN)\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m3)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m3, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f (OPTIMAL)\n\n", epv_m3))

cat("Model 4: VSURF Prediction + Demographics\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m4)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m4, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv_m4))

cat("EPV ASSESSMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(i in 1:4) {
  epv    <- c(epv_m1, epv_m2, epv_m3, epv_m4)[i]
  status <- ifelse(epv >= 10, "Adequate (>=10)",
                   ifelse(epv >= 5, "Borderline (5-10)", "Low (<5)"))
  cat(sprintf("  Model %d: EPV = %4.1f  %s\n", i, epv, status))
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: FIT MODELS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: FITTING MODELS ACROSS IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

fit_pooled_model <- function(imputed_list, formula_obj, model_name) {
  cat(sprintf("Fitting %s...\n", model_name))

  m    <- length(imputed_list)
  fits <- vector("list", m)

  for(i in 1:m) {
    fits[[i]] <- glm(formula_obj, data = imputed_list[[i]], family = binomial())
  }

  fit_mira <- structure(fits, class = c("mira", "matrix"))
  pooled   <- pool(fit_mira)

  cat(sprintf("  Done: %s\n", model_name))
  return(list(fit = fit_mira, pooled = pooled))
}

model1 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m1, "Model 1")
model2 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m2, "Model 2")
model3 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m3, "Model 3")
model4 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m4, "Model 4")

cat("\nAll models fitted\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART E: EXTRACT SUMMARIES
#==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Extracting summaries\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

get_summary <- function(pooled_obj, model_name) {
  summary(pooled_obj, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      OR_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      OR_CI    = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.10  ~ ".",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, OR_CI,
           statistic, p.value, sig)
}

summary_m1 <- get_summary(model1$pooled, "Model 1")
summary_m2 <- get_summary(model2$pooled, "Model 2")
summary_m3 <- get_summary(model3$pooled, "Model 3")
summary_m4 <- get_summary(model4$pooled, "Model 4")

all_summaries <- bind_rows(summary_m1, summary_m2, summary_m3, summary_m4)

cat("Summaries extracted\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART F: CALCULATE AUC
#==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Calculating AUC\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

calc_auc <- function(fit_mira, imputed_list, boot.n = 2000) {

  m      <- length(imputed_list)
  aucs   <- numeric(m)
  lowers <- numeric(m)
  uppers <- numeric(m)

  for(i in 1:m) {

    pred_i <- predict(fit_mira[[i]], type = "response")
    roc_i  <- roc(imputed_list[[i]][[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)

    aucs[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))

    # BOOTSTRAP CI
    ci_i <- ci.auc(roc_i, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot.n)

    lowers[i] <- ci_i[1]
    uppers[i] <- ci_i[3]
  }

  data.frame(
    AUC_mean  = mean(aucs),
    AUC_lower = mean(lowers),
    AUC_upper = mean(uppers)
  )
}

auc_m1 <- calc_auc(model1$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m2 <- calc_auc(model2$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m3 <- calc_auc(model3$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m4 <- calc_auc(model4$fit, imputed_list)

  Model        = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3", "Model 4"),

                   "VSURF Prediction + Demo"),

  EPV          = c(epv_m1, epv_m2, epv_m3, epv_m4),
  AUC          = c(auc_m1$AUC_mean, auc_m2$AUC_mean, auc_m3$AUC_mean, auc_m4$AUC_mean),
  AUC_Lower    = c(auc_m1$AUC_lower, auc_m2$AUC_lower, auc_m3$AUC_lower, auc_m4$AUC_lower),
  AUC_Upper    = c(auc_m1$AUC_upper, auc_m2$AUC_upper, auc_m3$AUC_upper, auc_m4$AUC_upper)
) %>%
  mutate(
    AUC_formatted = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", AUC, AUC_Lower, AUC_Upper),
    EPV_status    = ifelse(EPV >= 10, "Adequate",
                           ifelse(EPV >= 5, "Borderline", "Low"))
  )

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

print_results <- function(summary_df, model_name, desc, auc_stats) {
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat(model_name, ":", desc, "\n")
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n",
              auc_stats$AUC_mean, auc_stats$AUC_lower, auc_stats$AUC_upper))

  sig <- summary_df %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05) %>%
    select(term, OR_CI, p.value, sig)

  if(nrow(sig) > 0) {
    cat("Significant Predictors (p < .05):\n")
    print(sig, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No significant predictors (p < .05)\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

print_results(summary_m1, "MODEL 1", "VSURF Interpretation",       auc_m1)
print_results(summary_m2, "MODEL 2", "VSURF Interpretation + Demo", auc_m2)
print_results(summary_m3, "MODEL 3", "VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY",  auc_m3)
print_results(summary_m4, "MODEL 4", "VSURF Prediction + Demo",     auc_m4)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

consistency_check <- personality_prediction %>%
  map_df(function(pred) {
    m3_row <- summary_m3 %>% filter(term == pred)
    m4_row <- summary_m4 %>% filter(term == pred)

    tibble(
      Predictor = pred,
      M3_OR  = if(nrow(m3_row) > 0) m3_row$OR      else NA_real_,
      M3_p   = if(nrow(m3_row) > 0) m3_row$p.value else NA_real_,
      M3_sig = if(nrow(m3_row) > 0) m3_row$sig      else "",
      M4_OR  = if(nrow(m4_row) > 0) m4_row$OR      else NA_real_,
      M4_p   = if(nrow(m4_row) > 0) m4_row$p.value else NA_real_,
      M4_sig = if(nrow(m4_row) > 0) m4_row$sig      else ""
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Consistent_sig = (M3_p < 0.05) & (M4_p < 0.05),
        OR_change_pct  = 100 * (M4_OR - M3_OR) / M3_OR
      )
  })

cat("Prediction set variables across Models 3 & 4:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(consistency_check %>%
        select(Predictor, M3_OR, M3_p, M3_sig, M4_OR, M4_p, M4_sig, OR_change_pct))
cat("\n")

n_consistent <- sum(consistency_check$Consistent_sig, na.rm = TRUE)

            n_consistent, nrow(consistency_check)))
```

## Cross-Validation
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION ON IMPUTED DATA (REVISED FOR NEW MODELS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Internal validation using 10-fold CV across all imputations
# Why imputed data: Complete cases (75.8%) may be biased; imputed data
#                   reflects full sample and our actual analysis approach
# Method: Perform CV on each imputation, then pool results
# Updated: Now uses Model 3 (VSURF Prediction) as primary model
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CROSS-VALIDATION: IMPUTED DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND MODEL
#==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Loading data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data (mids object - consistent with VSURF and regression chunks)
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed data with %d imputations\n", mids_data$m))

# Build imputed list from mids object
imputed_list <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) complete(mids_data, i))
cat(sprintf("✓ Extracted %d complete datasets\n", length(imputed_list)))

# Load final regression results (REVISED VERSION)
if(!file.exists("final_regression_results_revised.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run final regression chunk first to create final_regression_results_revised.rds")
}

final_results <- readRDS("final_regression_results_revised.rds")

# Use Model 3 (VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY)
model_vars  <- final_results$variables$model3
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

cat(sprintf("\nModel: Model 3 (VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY)\n"))
cat(sprintf("Predictors: %s\n", paste(model_vars, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Imputations: %d\n", length(imputed_list)))
cat(sprintf("Sample size: %d per imputation\n\n", nrow(imputed_list[[1]])))

#==============================================================================
# PART B: CALCULATE APPARENT PERFORMANCE
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: APPARENT PERFORMANCE (NO CV)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

formula_obj <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(model_vars, collapse = " + ")))

apparent_aucs <- numeric(length(imputed_list))

for(m in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  data_m  <- imputed_list[[m]]
  model_m <- glm(formula_obj, data = data_m, family = binomial())
  pred_m  <- predict(model_m, type = "response")
  roc_m   <- roc(data_m[[outcome_var]], pred_m, quiet = TRUE)
  apparent_aucs[m] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_m))
}

apparent_auc_mean <- mean(apparent_aucs)
apparent_auc_sd   <- sd(apparent_aucs)

cat("Apparent performance (fitted on full data):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean AUC: %.3f\n", apparent_auc_mean))
cat(sprintf("SD AUC:   %.3f\n", apparent_auc_sd))
cat(sprintf("Range:    %.3f to %.3f\n\n", min(apparent_aucs), max(apparent_aucs)))

#==============================================================================
# PART C: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION ON EACH IMPUTATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Settings:\n")
cat("  Method: 10-fold CV\n")
cat("  Repetitions: Performed on each imputation separately\n")
cat("  Pooling: Average across imputations\n\n")

cv_one_imputation <- function(data, formula_obj, outcome_var, n_folds = 10, seed = 123) {

  set.seed(seed)
  n        <- nrow(data)
  fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = n))

  fold_aucs <- numeric(n_folds)
  all_preds <- numeric(n)
  all_obs   <- numeric(n)

  for(k in 1:n_folds) {
    train_data <- data[fold_ids != k, ]
    test_data  <- data[fold_ids == k, ]

    model_k <- glm(formula_obj, data = train_data, family = binomial())
    pred_k  <- predict(model_k, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

    all_preds[fold_ids == k] <- pred_k
    all_obs[fold_ids == k]   <- test_data[[outcome_var]]

    roc_k       <- roc(test_data[[outcome_var]], pred_k, quiet = TRUE)
    fold_aucs[k] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_k))
  }

  roc_overall <- roc(all_obs, all_preds, quiet = TRUE)
  overall_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_overall))

  list(
    overall_auc   = overall_auc,
    fold_aucs     = fold_aucs,
    mean_fold_auc = mean(fold_aucs),
    sd_fold_auc   = sd(fold_aucs)
  )
}

cat("Running cross-validation on each imputation...\n")

cv_results_list <- vector("list", length(imputed_list))

for(m in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %d/%d...\r", m, length(imputed_list)))
  cv_results_list[[m]] <- cv_one_imputation(
    data        = imputed_list[[m]],
    formula_obj = formula_obj,
    outcome_var = outcome_var,
    n_folds     = 10,
    seed        = 123
  )
}

cat("\nCross-validation complete\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: POOL CV RESULTS ACROSS IMPUTATIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: POOLED CV RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cv_aucs      <- sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$overall_auc)
cv_auc_mean  <- mean(cv_aucs)
cv_auc_sd    <- sd(cv_aucs)

cat("Cross-validated performance:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean CV AUC: %.3f\n", cv_auc_mean))
cat(sprintf("SD:          %.3f\n", cv_auc_sd))
cat(sprintf("Range:       %.3f to %.3f\n\n", min(cv_aucs), max(cv_aucs)))

optimism_mean <- apparent_auc_mean - cv_auc_mean
optimism_sd   <- sqrt(apparent_auc_sd^2 + cv_auc_sd^2)

cat("Optimism (Apparent - CV):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean optimism: %.3f\n", optimism_mean))
cat(sprintf("SD:            %.3f\n\n", optimism_sd))

#==============================================================================
# PART E: FOLD-LEVEL ANALYSIS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: FOLD-LEVEL STABILITY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

fold_summary <- tibble(
  Fold     = 1:10,
  Mean_AUC = numeric(10),
  SD_AUC   = numeric(10)
)

for(k in 1:10) {
  fold_aucs_k            <- sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$fold_aucs[k])
  fold_summary$Mean_AUC[k] <- mean(fold_aucs_k)
  fold_summary$SD_AUC[k]   <- sd(fold_aucs_k)
}

cat("Fold-by-fold performance (averaged across imputations):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(fold_summary)

cat(sprintf("\nMean fold AUC:   %.3f\n", mean(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)))
cat(sprintf("SD across folds: %.3f\n", sd(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)))
cat(sprintf("Range:           %.3f to %.3f\n\n",
            min(fold_summary$Mean_AUC), max(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)))

#==============================================================================
# PART F: INTERPRETATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: INTERPRETATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(optimism_mean < 0.02) {
  interpretation <- "MINIMAL optimism (<0.02)"
  detail         <- "Model shows excellent generalizability. Cross-validated performance\nis very close to apparent performance."
  recommendation <- "Report apparent AUC with note of CV validation. Model is robust."
} else if(optimism_mean < 0.05) {
  interpretation <- "MODERATE optimism (0.02-0.05)"
  detail         <- "Model shows acceptable generalizability. Some optimism present but\nwithin normal range for sample size."
  recommendation <- "Report both apparent and CV AUC. Use CV estimate for external\nvalidation planning."
} else {
  interpretation <- "SUBSTANTIAL optimism (>0.05)"
  detail         <- "Model shows concerning overfitting. Apparent performance significantly\noverestimates true discrimination."
  recommendation <- "Report CV AUC as primary estimate. Consider further model simplification.\nExternal validation critical."
}

cat(interpretation, "\n\n")
cat(detail, "\n\n")
cat("Recommendation:\n")
cat(recommendation, "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART G: SAVE RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

performance_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Apparent AUC (Mean)", "CV AUC (Mean)", "Optimism",
             "Apparent SD", "CV SD"),
  Value  = c(apparent_auc_mean, cv_auc_mean, optimism_mean,
             apparent_auc_sd, cv_auc_sd),
  Interpretation = c(
    sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", min(apparent_aucs), max(apparent_aucs)),
    sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", min(cv_aucs), max(cv_aucs)),
    ifelse(optimism_mean < 0.02, "Minimal",
           ifelse(optimism_mean < 0.05, "Moderate", "Substantial")),
    "Variability across imputations",
    "Variability across imputations"
  )
)

cv_details <- tibble(
  Imputation   = 1:length(imputed_list),
  Apparent_AUC = apparent_aucs,
  CV_AUC       = cv_aucs,
  Optimism     = apparent_aucs - cv_aucs
)

report <- c(
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "CROSS-VALIDATION ON IMPUTED DATA - SUMMARY (REVISED)",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "",
  "MODEL: Model 3 (VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY)",
  sprintf("Predictors: %d (%s)", length(model_vars), paste(model_vars, collapse = ", ")),
  sprintf("Sample size: %d", nrow(imputed_list[[1]])),
  sprintf("Imputations: %d", length(imputed_list)),
  "",
  "PERFORMANCE:",
  sprintf("  Apparent AUC: %.3f (SD: %.3f)", apparent_auc_mean, apparent_auc_sd),
  sprintf("  CV AUC:       %.3f (SD: %.3f)", cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_sd),
  sprintf("  Optimism:     %.3f", optimism_mean),
  "",
  "INTERPRETATION:",
  paste(" ", interpretation),
  "",
  detail,
  "",
  "RECOMMENDATION:",
  recommendation,
  "",
  "FOLD STABILITY:",
  sprintf("  Mean:  %.3f", mean(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)),
  sprintf("  SD:    %.3f", sd(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)),
  sprintf("  Range: %.3f to %.3f", min(fold_summary$Mean_AUC), max(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)),
  "",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
)

write_csv(performance_summary, "cv_imputed_performance_summary_revised.csv")
write_csv(fold_summary,        "cv_imputed_fold_summary_revised.csv")
write_csv(cv_details,          "cv_imputed_by_imputation_revised.csv")
writeLines(report,             "cv_imputed_summary_report_revised.txt")

cat("Saved: cv_imputed_performance_summary_revised.csv\n")
cat("Saved: cv_imputed_fold_summary_revised.csv\n")

for(line in report) cat(line, "\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```
